# Brief

## Specification

Updated `specs/greeting.md` to define the requested behavior in observable,
implementation-neutral terms: normal mode preserves `Hello, NAME!` and the
`World` default; `--loud` enables loud mode only as the first argument and
uppercases the complete greeting; both modes select the first name argument and
ignore later arguments. Acceptance criteria cover default and named greetings
in normal and loud modes. The unsupported Ruby-specific and Unicode-specific
casing requirements were removed in response to review.

The OKF bundle contains two Markdown files; its reserved-file rules,
frontmatter, concept type, index entry, and links were checked successfully.
